description: Glossary of Terms is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Glossary of Terms dataset contains a list of terms used throughout our Portal and supporting documentation, with a definition and associated acronyms if applicable. For ease of use, we recommend using the custom "Index" tab for this dataset, not the standard table, as this will allow you to view the full definition. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Open Data Function. The portal shows 2024-10-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
